project.title: Project
project.summary: A billable or internal delivery project for a client, tracked through phases and synced to the Shillinq project ledger.
project.description: Projects are the delivery vehicle for client work in Pipelinq. Each project carries budget (hours and amount), a billable flag, a start/end date window and a lifecycle status (open, in_progress, completed, cancelled). On creation and on every status change the project is dispatched to Shillinq's project ledger via OpenRegister's WebhookService; ledgerSyncStatus and ledgerSyncedAt record the outcome of that one-way integration.

client.description: UUID of the related client (pipelinq client schema).
client.title: Client

status.description: Project lifecycle status. Mapped to Shillinq ledger phase names on dispatch.
status.title: Status

billable.description: Whether the project is billable to the client.
billable.title: Billable

budgetAmount.description: Budgeted amount in the reporting currency.
budgetAmount.title: Budget Amount

hourlyRate.description: Default hourly rate applied to the project.
hourlyRate.title: Hourly Rate

color.description: Display colour (hex) for the project in the UI.
color.title: Color

ledgerSyncStatus.description: Shillinq ledger sync state. Null for projects created before the ledger integration was deployed.
ledgerSyncStatus.title: Ledger Sync Status

ledgerSyncedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last successful ledger sync delivery.
ledgerSyncedAt.title: Ledger Synced At

projectPhase.title: Project Phase
projectPhase.summary: A named phase within a project with its own status; phase status changes are dispatched to the Shillinq ledger in the parent project's context.
projectPhase.description: Phases break a project into delivery stages (e.g. discovery, build, hypercare). A phase carries its own status; when it changes, the ledger integration fetches the parent project and dispatches a status-changed event in the project's context rather than per phase.

sequence.description: Ordering of the phase within the project.
sequence.title: Sequence
